changeSet.author: trainer
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO trades (trade_ref, instrument_id, counterparty_id, asset_class, side, quantity, price, trade_date, status, created_at) SELECT 'TRD-2026-' || LPAD(n::text,6,'0') AS trade_ref, 1 + (n % 15) AS instrument_id, 1 + (n % 10) AS counterparty_id, (ARRAY['EQUITY','FIXED_INCOME','FX','COMMODITY','DERIVATIVE'])[1 + (n % 5)] AS asset_class, (ARRAY['BUY','SELL'])[1 + (n % 2)] AS side, ROUND((random() * 10000 + 1)::numeric,4) AS quantity, ROUND((random() * 500 + 1)::numeric,4) AS price, DATE '2026-04-01' + (n % 120) AS trade_date, (ARRAY['PENDING','MATCHED','UNMATCHED','DISPUTED','MATCHED','MATCHED'])[1 + (n % 6)] AS status, now() AS created_at FROM generate_series(1,500) AS s(n);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM trades WHERE trade_ref LIKE 'TRD-2026-%';
